```{r}
# function for easier navigation of relative refs
nested_here <- function(
    ...,    
    parent_dir = params$parent_dir, 
    version    = params$version
) {
  here::here(parent_dir, version, ...)
}
```

```{r}
# # (maybe) create subdirectories for code, data, output
walk(nested_here(c("R", "data", "data-raw", "output", "output/tables", "output/models")), ~{
  if(!dir.exists(.x)) {dir.create(.x, recursive = TRUE)}
  })

# define custom functions
source(nested_here("R", "r00_setup.R"))
```


```{r}

  ) |>
```

```{r}
openxlsx::read.xlsx(
  yoy_changes |> 
  separate(years, c("to", "from"), sep = "-") |> 
  mutate(
    years = glue::glue(
      "from 20{gsub('.', '-20', from, fixed = TRUE)} to 20{gsub('.', '-20', to, fixed = TRUE)}"
      ), 
    change = emmean,
    .after = 1, 
    .keep = "unused"
    ) |> 
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(
    nested_here("output", "tables", "t1_yoy_changes.xlsx"),
    asTable = TRUE
    ),
  nested_here("output", "tables", "t1_yoy_changes.xlsx")
  )
```


```{r}
yoy_changes |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    variable, emmean, group = years, 
    ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, 
    color = factor(I(p.value <= 0.05)))
    ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(size = 0.3) +
  # geom_linerange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  # facet_wrap(variable ~ ., scales = "free") +
  facet_grid(. ~ years) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
```

# Write Results

```{r}
out_tables <- list(
  About = t(data.frame(
    Date   = Sys.Date(),
    Author = "Rachel Lane",
    Title  = "SOW 2 Tables"
  )) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  set_names("value") |> 
  rownames_to_column("name")
  )
out_tables[["About"]] <- rbind(
  out_tables[["About"]],
  params |> 
    keep_at(~ grepl("raw", .x)) |> 
    set_names_from_child("clean_name") |> 
    map_dfr(~data.frame(
      name = "Data Sources",
      value = glue::glue("File: {.x$file}. Sheet: {coalesce(.x$sheet, '1')}. Box file ID: {.x$box_id}")
      )))

```

```{r}
for (f in list.files(
  nested_here("output", "tables"),
  "sow3"
  )) {
  d <- read_rds(nested_here("output", "tables", f))
  out_tables[[attr(d, "sheetname")]] <- d
  out_tables$About <- out_tables$About |> 
    add_case(
      name = "Contents",
      value = glue::glue('Sheet: {attr(d, "sheetname")}. Title: {attr(d, "title")}. Description: {attr(d, "description")}')
    )
  }

```

```{r}
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  out_tables,
  nested_here("output", paste0("sow3_tables_", Sys.Date(), ".xlsx")),
  asTable = TRUE
)
```
